scope.compatibilityTarget: Payment.clientId -> Client.id when a customer profile exists

method.notes: Entries group repeated tests and consumers by one relation contract; locations identify every production family and every non-production family that consumes that contract.

entries.relation: payments records are schemaless app_data JSON; Payment.clientId is the only stored business identity field before Stage I-G
entries.readPath: getData('payments') through generic CRUD and finance/report routes
entries.requiredAction: add optional counterpartyId without a destructive schema rewrite; preserve clientId

entries.relation: withClientLink and normalizeClientRelationLinks validate/enrich clientId; rental enrichment copies clientId and display client text; no Counterparty resolver is applied
entries.readPath: GET /api/payments and GET /api/payments/:id return raw records
entries.requiredAction: canonicalize every Payment write with deterministic ID-only resolver and decorate API reads with Counterparty identity

entries.relation: strict Payment fields allow clientId/client but reject counterpartyId
entries.requiredAction: allow counterpartyId as a stable relation field while keeping system-field protections

entries.relation: write roles are admin/office; manager reads use rentalId first and stable counterpartyId/clientId scoped-rental fallback
entries.requiredAction: retain permissions; add regression coverage for Counterparty-only payments and ensure no label scoping

entries.relation: rentalId enriches Payment.clientId/objectId/contractId and client snapshot, but does not copy Rental.counterpartyId; the UI also copies only rental.clientId/client
entries.readPath: selected rental pre-fills the payment form
entries.requiredAction: make Rental.counterpartyId authoritative and copy both stable IDs without deriving identity from snapshots

entries.surface: Payment API search, sort, and filtering
entries.relation: search reads client/clientName/clientId text; filter uses exact clientId; no counterpartyId filter or Counterparty metadata discovery
entries.requiredAction: add exact counterpartyId filtering and Counterparty metadata search functions; keep names discovery-only

entries.relation: new Payment requires a Client profile and emits clientId/client; supplier-only and contractor-only Counterparties cannot be selected
entries.readPath: clients list and rental list populate the form
entries.requiredAction: select an active Counterparty by stable ID, optionally retain the corresponding Client ID, and never create a fake Client

entries.relation: display uses payment.client/clientName; missing clientId is recovered by unique client company-name matching to build a /clients/:id link
entries.requiredAction: remove name-based identifier recovery; use Payment.counterpartyId and Payment.clientId only

entries.surface: Payments page filtering and CSV export
entries.relation: clientId drives filters; display labels are exported; quick-action clientName can discover a Client and then sets clientId
entries.readPath: paginated Payment API and current-page export
entries.requiredAction: use counterpartyId for Payment filtering; retain clientId quick-action compatibility only when an explicit Client ID exists; labels remain display/export snapshots

entries.relation: Payment type exposes clientId/client but not counterpartyId or Counterparty DTO
entries.requiredAction: add counterpartyId and Counterparty summary to the type and mutation payload contract

entries.relation: search supports stable ID, legalName, shortName, INN, KPP, email, phone and returns Counterparty.id
entries.requiredAction: reuse for discovery only; do not use search results as an implicit resolver

entries.relation: paymentId is canonical to Payment; rentalId/documentId/objectId/contractId are stable; clientId limits customer allocation candidates
entries.readPath: allocation preview, debt allocation and Payment detail
entries.requiredAction: leave clientId compatibility for customer receivables; ensure Payment.counterpartyId changes are allocation-guarded

entries.relation: Payment joins Rental through rentalId/payment allocations; identity labels are not used
entries.requiredAction: no identity migration; add counterpartyId to protected allocated-Payment relation fields

entries.relation: cash application joins by paymentId/rentalId; debt grouping remains customer-specific through Rental.clientId; unlinked fallback keys may contain display text but do not persist relations
entries.requiredAction: preserve calculations; document clientId grouping as customer-profile compatibility and prohibit it from resolving Payment identity

entries.relation: Payment amount/date/status drive cash-in; client/clientName is copied only as a display label
entries.requiredAction: preserve numeric behavior; prefer canonical Counterparty display when available

entries.relation: payments are scoped first; rental/allocation IDs drive totals; clientId drives customer debt views
entries.readPath: finance/report, aging, dashboard and reports endpoints
entries.requiredAction: keep Finance-specific aggregates unchanged; allow compatibility clientId reads after Payment canonicalization

entries.relation: payments join by paymentId/rentalId; manager scope is stable rental/manager IDs; investor cannot read Payments collection
entries.readPath: manager report and scoped report endpoints
entries.requiredAction: regression test only; do not broaden investor permissions

entries.relation: finance_operations.counterparty and company_expenses.counterparty are free-text display fields, not stable relations
entries.writePath: manual finance operation and expense forms
entries.requiredAction: do not reinterpret text as identity in Stage I-G; Payment-derived Finance rows must use Payment.counterpartyId; a later subtype-specific migration can add canonical relations to expense entities

entries.relation: Payment.client is projected into an operation counterparty display string; text filtering is discovery/display only
entries.requiredAction: prefer Payment.counterparty DTO for display and retain stable Payment.counterpartyId on projected rows

entries.surface: Documents, contracts and invoices adjacent to Payments
entries.relation: documentId/contractId/rentalId are stable; clientId remains a customer compatibility link; document labels/numbers are snapshots
entries.readPath: allocation backfill, Payment allocation editor, receivable documents
entries.requiredAction: preserve stable adjacent IDs; do not expand into a full Documents/Contracts migration

entries.relation: Payment amounts join to Rental by rentalId; no Payment/client name relation writes
entries.requiredAction: no change; numeric regression coverage through existing suite

entries.relation: Payment.clientId can be recovered only from stable rentalId; names/INN are logged and rejected
entries.requiredAction: retain stable rental recovery but ensure canonical Payment.counterpartyId is handled only by the dedicated Stage I-G migration/write resolver

entries.relation: checks Payment.clientId first, then falls back to exact client display-name equality for legacy rows
entries.requiredAction: remove Payment display-name fallback; use stable Payment.clientId/counterpartyId only

entries.surface: Demo seed and local mock persistence
entries.relation: seeded Payments contain clientId/client but no counterpartyId; local storage bulk sync uses the Payment type
entries.readPath: demo reset and optional local storage
entries.requiredAction: emit canonical counterpartyId in demo Payments and rely on canonical bulk-write validation

entries.surface: Settings export/import and destructive demo cleanup
entries.relation: Payments are counted/read and can be bulk-cleared; no dedicated Payment CSV import exists; Rental CSV exports/imports stable counterpartyId
entries.requiredAction: allow empty canonical bulk replace; do not invent name/INN Payment import recovery

entries.relation: system-data export preserves Payment snapshots; system-data import bulk-restores payments outside generic CRUD and previously accepted client-only or metadata-only identity
entries.requiredAction: canonicalize imported Payments against staged Counterparty/Client/Rental collections with the ID-only resolver; reject ambiguous, missing, mismatched, archived, or metadata-only links

entries.relation: ENABLE_LEGACY_SYNC=1 allows an admin bulk Payment replacement outside generic CRUD; before Stage I-G it accepted client-only and metadata-only relations
entries.requiredAction: canonicalize the full Payment batch before any write using staged imported Client/Counterparty IDs; retain the endpoint's disabled-by-default policy

entries.relation: separate companyId/branchId/clientId SQL model with its own canonical payment prototypes; safety tests explicitly isolate it from legacy payments/payment_allocations app_data
entries.readPath: feature-gated canonical receivables APIs and foundation repositories
entries.requiredAction: do not couple Stage I-G legacy Payment migration to this track; record future Counterparty alignment risk

entries.relation: fixtures primarily model clientId/customer payments and stable rental/payment allocation joins
entries.requiredAction: add Stage I-G focused resolver/migration/API/filter/auth tests and retain existing calculation assertions

entries.relation: source assertions expect clientId filters and client-based Payment selection
entries.requiredAction: update assertions for stable counterpartyId while preserving customer allocation compatibility

entries.relation: exercises Finance API authorization, pagination, display and dashboards; no supplier-only Payment scenario exists
entries.writePath: test fixtures and Payment UI actions
